thread:
maria: Heads up — API ref example for /v1/generate shows a 200 response with a full result object, but prod returns 202 for queued jobs. Users are confused and SDK snippets are inconsistent. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789

sam: Which page is it on? I got a support ticket about a mismatch earlier.

maria: docs/reference/generate.md — the response sample currently has "status": "queued" *and* a "result" object. That combo is misleading.

jess: Is this breaking any doc-driven tests? I noticed Ruby doc tests flaked.

sam: Yep — internal snippets in clients assume immediate result. Need to show both async (202/queued) and sync (200/result) flows or mark result nullable.

maria: Proposed change: update the OpenAPI response schema to mark `result` as nullable, update the sample to show a 202 queued payload, and add an explicit sync example (query param ?wait_for_completion=true) so examples cover both.

nnamdi: +1. Also please add a short migration note for teams parsing response.body directly — they'll need to handle `result` being null.

jess: I'll update the JS and Python snippet to check status before accessing result. Suggest adding this tiny pattern:

```js
if (resp.status === 202) {
  // poll until ready
} else {
  use(resp.result)
}
```

sam: Good. For the OpenAPI file, I'll add a 202 example object and mark `result` as nullable in the 200 schema.

maria: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — tagging @jess @sam for snippet and schema review. I want to land by EOD.

jess: On it. I'll push a small change to the py snippet and add a unit test for the example flow.

sam: I'll also update the example responses in the `openapi.yaml` and regenerate the HTML examples.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-789--docs.redwood.ai (build succeeded) :white_check_mark: 

nnamdi: Thanks — can we add a one-line changelog entry for this week? Support needs to reference it in KB.

maria: Yes — adding to the docs changelog: "Clarified /v1/generate response examples (202 queued vs 200 immediate)".

jess: Quick Q: should we also harmonize param names? I saw `max_new_tokens` in one example and `max_tokens` in another, which confuses users.

maria: Let's not mix that into this PR. Create a follow-up ticket for param-name migration guidance and link it from this PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/412

sam: Sounds good. I'll ensure client tests accept nullable `result` so SDK releases don't break.

jess: Reviewing PR now. Small nit: update the Python example to use the response.status check rather than try/except on KeyError. :eyes: 

maria: Thanks — I pushed a short note in the PR about the expected behavior per deployment tier (hosted vs dedicated).

support: FYI — I've started a support KB draft referencing the updated examples and how to handle queued responses.

nnamdi: After merge, please ping SDK leads so we can coordinate a minor client patch and release notes.

maria: Will do. Merging after approvals.

sam: Nice. Closing loop: once merged, I'll update the OpenAPI spec in the platform repo too.

maria: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.
